channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: BTS 2026-2027 world tour: Full schedule and where to buy tickets
item.description: See all BTS world tour dates for 2026-2027. Learn where to buy official tickets, what cities they're visiting, and how to get early access.

item.title: The biggest trend in Gen Z dating is the search for a steady life with financial stability, says Coffee Meets Bagel's CEO
item.description: CMB's CEO, Quincy Yang, said the American dream has become unaffordable without dual incomes, and daters are seeking financially stable partners.

item.title: Donald Trump won't take Air Force One to Davos after an electrical issue forced a U-turn
item.description: Air Force One headed back to Joint Base Andrews after it ran into a "minor electrical issue," per a White House pool report.

item.title: Amazon CEO says that tariffs are starting to 'creep' into prices as vendors run out of stockpiled goods
item.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said that retailers are running out of stockpiled goods imported before tariffs and "don't have endless options."

item.title: xAI cofounder is taking a step back to 'go founder mode on my health' after Lyme disease diagnosis
item.description: An xAI cofounder is stepping back after a Lyme disease diagnosis, shifting into an advisory role to "go founder mode on my health."

item.title: Coca-Cola's CEO said the company is eyeing a big healthy food trend — and it's not protein
item.description: Coca-Cola CEO James Quincey said customers might see fiber creep into the company's drinks this year.

item.title: Trump laid out his plans to restrict institutional housing investors — with some notable carveouts
item.description: The order comes with a carveout: build-to-rent properties that were designed to be rental communities will not be affected.

item.title: Singer Anne-Marie says motherhood didn't come naturally at first. With her second baby, she did things differently.
item.description: "I just was like, I don't know how to be a mom, and I thought it would just come, because everyone tells you that," singer Anne-Marie said.

item.title: Some tech workers want their CEOs to 'call the White House' and speak out against ICE
item.description: A small group of tech workers, including Google and Amazon employees, signed a petition calling on CEOs to speak out against the federal agency.

item.title: Ukraine's pay-per-kill system against Russian Shaheds helped it get 40,000 interceptor drones in a month, official says
item.description: Fedorov said that Ukrainian forces are expecting to field 40,000 interceptor drones in January alone, a significant boost to its arsenal.
